repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaacEFVpyQ6C5mcRQs

Decision analysis · 2026-11-25T23:48Z · decision thread for zone o5-U (inbox 7177906101)

## 维护者速读

- 问题：行内编辑已全部改成「改一格存一格」，但表格组件还留着旧的「攒一批、点全部保存」模式和它的保存接口。平台自己已经没有任何可编辑表格在用这套旧模式，只有外部用代码接入表格的人还能打开它。要么旧模式连接口一起退掉，要么留着，这张退接口的卡就作废。
- 选项：A 旧模式和批量保存接口一起退役，表格只剩「改一格存一格」，1 个前端 PR；B 保留旧模式给外部代码接入者，这张卡关闭不做；C 只退接口、留旧模式开关，但这样开关就成了空壳，不可取。
- 推荐 A：一个表格只应有一种保存方式，留一条平台自己不用、也不测的旧路，日后只会在升级时坏掉。
- 不定会怎样：这张卡一直挂着；外部接入者按文档能开出一条平台自己从不走的旧模式。

## Background

#35683 (list inline-edit redo) made every editable grid select-first with per-cell save: PR #35747 for `ListView` grids (maintainer ruling 7035276698 on #35683), PR #36357 (#36270) for every other editable `ObjectGrid`, retiring `singleClickEdit`. This card (#35827) was filed to retire `DataTableSchema.onBatchSave` once nothing calls it. On `origin/main` 98bda0ac the slot still has callers: `data-table.tsx:3321` calls it from "Save All" whenever `autosaves` is false, and `ObjectGrid.tsx:4121` wires `onBatchSave ?? defaultBatchSave`. The staged model is reached by (a) a React host passing `cellSelection={false}` on an editable `ObjectGrid` (documented at `ObjectGrid.tsx:547`, `objectql.ts:1391`), or (b) a bare `data-table` node handed `editable` with no `GridCellSelection` mounted. The seat 3 reading 7118602927 and the zone inbox measured this; retiring the slot as filed also retires the staged opt-out, which is a narrowing of a published host prop wider than the card.

## Governing text

- AGENTS.md Prime Directive 10 corollary (the card's citation): "never advertise or demo a capability the runtime doesn't actually deliver (declared ≠ enforced) — fix it, trim it, or file an issue … Trim what can never be enforced, implement the rest, and keep the claim as narrow as the enforcement" — `sed -n 234,237p AGENTS.md`
- ADR-0087 metadata protocol upgrade contract: a retirement owes a FROM/TO prescription in the changeset — `grep -n "FROM … TO\|FROM/TO" docs/adr/0087-metadata-protocol-upgrade-contract.md | head -3`
- Maintainer ruling 7076617499 on #36270 (per PR #36357 body): "one editing model"; the PR marked `onBatchSave` `@deprecated` and documented `cellSelection={false}` as the staged model's only door.
- `ObjectGrid.tsx:540–549` `@deprecated objectstack#36270 … Pass onRowSave to own the write per cell, or pass cellSelection={false} to keep the staged model, where this handler is still called.` — `sed -n 540,549p ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`
- SKILL.md ④: 创业阶段不渐进 — 废弃能力默认立即退休,无分阶段窗口;staged 仅凭具名外部用户证据方可荐。

## Protocol

`@object-ui/types` published surface: `DataTableSchema.onBatchSave` (runtime slot, zod refuses it by name) and `ObjectGridComponentProps.cellSelection`'s `false` arm (host prop). Removing both is `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`, ADR-0087 entry with FROM `onBatchSave` / `cellSelection={false}` TO `onRowSave` per cell. No `@objectstack/spec` change (`singleClickEdit` is already retired).

## Premises (each with a re-check)

1. `onBatchSave` is still called from Save All when `autosaves` is false — `sed -n 1679,1683p ui/packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx; sed -n 3321,3323p ui/packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx`
2. `ObjectGrid` still wires `onBatchSave ?? defaultBatchSave` and documents `cellSelection={false}` as the staged door — `grep -n "defaultBatchSave\|cellSelection={false}" ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`
3. The one in-tree `cellSelection={false}` host (`ResourceListPage.tsx:1501`, metadata admin list, #36897) is read-only (`editable: false`), so it never reaches the staged save — `grep -n "editable" ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/metadataListGrid.ts; grep -rn "cellSelection={false}" ui/packages ui/apps --include=*.tsx | grep -v test`
4. No in-tree host passes its own `onBatchSave`; dashboard `data-table` nodes have no save path (PR #36357 body) — `grep -rn "onBatchSave" ui/packages --include=*.tsx | grep -v "test\|types/src\|data-table.tsx\|ObjectGrid.tsx"`
5. 23 plugin-grid test files pin (PR #36357 said 25) the staged path through `cellSelection={false}` (PR #36357 body) — `grep -rln "cellSelection={false}" ui/packages/plugin-grid/src | wc -l`
6. Downstream repos (hotcrm, gallery) were censused for `singleClickEdit` only, not for `cellSelection={false}` or `onBatchSave` (PR #36357 body) — not re-measurable here.

## The question in one sentence

The platform has one way to save an inline edit, but still ships a second, unused way that only outside code can switch on, and the card to remove its save hook cannot be built without removing that switch too.

## Options × real cost × workload

| | What | What the person sees | Workload |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | Retire the staged model with its slot: `cellSelection` loses its `false` arm (a host may still pass `true`; absent = editable ⇒ select-first, read-only ⇒ click-to-open); `data-table` always saves per cell when editable (an editable `data-table` with no `onRowSave` is refused loudly at the node, or the grid's own `dataSource.update` is the write where `ObjectGrid` is the host, as today); the pending-changes bar, "Save All" and `onBatchSave` are deleted from `data-table`, `ObjectGrid`, `@object-ui/types` and the zod mirror; the staged-path pins are migrated or deleted; ADR-0087 FROM/TO in the changeset. | No change for any in-repo screen (none uses the staged model). An outside React host that passes `cellSelection={false}` or `onBatchSave` gets a type error at upgrade and the FROM/TO line. | domain:ui 1 PR, size M–L (data-table staged branch removal is the bulk). Precedent: PR #36357 (+1221/−201, 60 files) retired `singleClickEdit` and moved the default; this removes more code and adds none. |
| B | Keep the staged model as a documented host opt-out and close #35827 (not planned): `onBatchSave` stays because it has a caller. | Nothing changes. Two saving models remain in the table primitive; the second is untested in any in-repo screen except by unit pins. | 0 PRs. The card's premise is false as filed, so it closes with the reason. |
| C | Retire `onBatchSave` only, keep `cellSelection={false}`. | A host that keeps the staged model has a Save All bar that can send nothing. | domain:ui 1 PR, size S. Rejected: it creates exactly the dead promise the card was filed to remove. |

Business translation: A = the table has one way to save, the one every screen uses; B = the platform keeps a spare editing mode for a customer it has not met; C = a Save button that does nothing.

## Four axes (business stance)

- **Real business need (②)** — measured: zero in-repo editable grids use the staged model; the only `cellSelection={false}` host is read-only; no host passes `onBatchSave`. The maintainer ruled one editing model on #36270. No named outside user of the staged door is on record (PR #36357 censused downstream for `singleClickEdit` only). Zero pull for keeping it, zero pull for keeping the card open either; the pull is for one model.
- **Long-term fit (①)** — two years out the table has one editing contract: select a cell, edit, each cell writes on its own through `onRowSave` or the grid's data source; that is how spreadsheets-on-records (Airtable, Notion, Salesforce inline edit on list views) behave, and it is what #35683 ruled. A second staged contract, reachable only by code, is a path nobody walks, nobody tests end to end and every later change (touch behaviour #36332, keyboard navigation #11068) has to special-case; PR #36357's body already lists such exceptions.
- **AI-error-proofing (③)** — an AI writing a React host reads `cellSelection?: boolean` and `onBatchSave?` and may wire a batch handler that is bypassed on every select-first grid (PR #36357 says so: "a host that passes onBatchSave alone … now has it bypassed") — a silent no-op today, which is the card's Prime Directive 10 point. With A the types cannot express it and the upgrade refuses it loudly. With B the silent no-op stays for the common path and works only behind an extra flag.
- **Startup focus (④)** — remove beats maintain: 创业阶段不渐进,无拉动的声明面退休。Keeping the staged model is declare-and-maintain for a door with no named user; staged retirement is not recommended because no outside user is on record.

os-decision-facets
① Long-term fit: one editing contract for the table; the staged branch is a second contract only code can reach and every later change must special-case.
② Business pull: zero in-repo users of the staged model (the one `cellSelection={false}` host is read-only); maintainer ruled one model on #36270; no named outside user.
③ AI-error-proofing: today `onBatchSave` on a select-first grid is a silent no-op; A makes the types refuse it; C would make Save All itself a no-op.
④ Startup focus: remove > declare-and-maintain; no staged window without a named external user.
Prior rulings read: onBatchSave · cellSelection · staged · Save All → 0 hits in coordinator/rulings.md and decisions/待决汇总.md; maintainer records 7035276698 (#35683 scope) and 7076617499 (#36270, one editing model, per PR #36357) read; ADR-0087 retirement contract; thread: none.

## Recommendation: A

Self-check: 只看①选 A;②③④ 是否翻转:否。

Confidence gaps: (a) hotcrm and gallery were not censused for `cellSelection={false}` / `onBatchSave` here (no access in this container); the dev censuses on claim and reports a fork if a named host exists. (b) The bare `data-table` primitive handed `editable` outside `ObjectGrid`: the PR body says no in-repo host reaches it; the dev confirms and decides between loud refusal and the grid's own write for that arm, both inside A. (c) Whether the parent-form child list (#35590 group-placed children) ever needs a saved-together batch: PR #36357 measured no such host; if one appears later it is a new card, not a reason to keep this door.

Not taken: B keeps a second saving model for a customer not on record; C is the dead promise the card exists to remove.

## Execution after the ruling (A)

1. The card is re-premised on claim: the title and Done-when become "retire the staged editing model (`cellSelection={false}` arm, pending-changes bar, Save All) together with `onBatchSave`"; `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`, ADR-0087 entry. Zone o5-U claims (`domain:ui`, size M–L).
2. Dev order: census downstream (`cellSelection={false}`, `onBatchSave`) first; then `data-table` loses the staged branch (`autosaves` becomes `selectFirst`-only or is removed), `ObjectGrid` loses `defaultBatchSave` and the `false` arm (`cellSelection?: true` or the prop becomes `never` for `false` with a tombstone), `@object-ui/types` removes the slot and rewrites the jsdoc at `data-display.ts` ~1544/1926, zod mirror and parity pins move; the staged pins migrate to select-first or are deleted with the behaviour they pinned; `keyboardNavigation`'s describe loses its staged sentence.
3. The changeset FROM/TO: FROM `cellSelection={false}` + `onBatchSave` TO select-first with `onRowSave` (one call per record) or the grid's own `dataSource.update`.

(2) `data-table` saves per cell whenever it is editable; the bare-primitive arm (editable, no `onRowSave`, no `ObjectGrid` host) is either refused loudly or written through the grid's own data source where `ObjectGrid` hosts it: the dev picks inside A and pins it. (3) Staged-path pins migrate to select-first or are deleted with the behaviour they pinned; `keyboardNavigation`'s describe loses its staged sentence. (4) `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`, ADR-0087 entry: FROM `cellSelection={false}` + `onBatchSave` TO select-first with `onRowSave` per record or the grid's own `dataSource.update`; dogfood battery on the final head (narrowing arm).
- Premise clause: before writing, the dev censuses hotcrm and gallery for `cellSelection={false}` and `onBatchSave`; a named outside host is reported as a fork, not worked around.
- State: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` in this write; zone o5-U (seat repo:objectstack#5) claims.
